subject: Postflight resilience check + runbook closure for VPC private deployment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Park <john.park@acmecloud.com>, Kate Summers <kate.summers@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Postflight resilience check + runbook closure for VPC private deployment

Hi John / Kate —

Great work on the deploy today. Before we close the post-deployment ticket I want to run through a short "postflight resilience" checklist so we can formally sign off and hand control back to ACME SRE. The list below is what the ops runbook will expect; I’ve attached the runbook PDF and the KV prefill log for reference.

Quick asks (30–45 minute window):
- Can your team confirm egress ACL spiral checks from the three tester subnets (east, west, on-prem) completed without intermittent resets? We ran an automated spiral and have a CSV attached with raw stats.
- Please validate that KV cache prefill reached >95% hit-rate for the 90s test window (see kv-prefill-log-20280509.txt).
- Confirm that the fallback-routing policy is propagating to the edge gateways (we configured rotational fallback lanes in the policy bundle).
- Smoke: issue 100 concurrent small-gen requests (seq len 32) and confirm latency p99 < 150ms for dedicated pool.

If all green, we’ll close INF-4823 and publish the ops closure note. If anything is off, reply with the specific failure and attach pcap or system traces where possible.

Attachments: redwood_runbook_postflight_v1.pdf, kv-prefill-log-20280509.txt, egress_acl_spiral_test_results.csv

Thanks —
Jonas
Director, Deployment Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: John Park <john.park@acmecloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kate Summers <kate.summers@acmecloud.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Postflight resilience check + runbook closure for VPC private deployment

Jonas —

Thanks for the checklist and the runbook. Quick status from our side after the 06:00 window:
- Egress ACL spiral: two brief retransmit spikes observed from on-prem tester to egress gateway (dropped packets ~0.6% over two minutes). We have pcap excerpts and the spike timestamps in the CSV.
- KV prefill: overall hit-rate averaged 93% across the three nodes (below your 95% threshold). We saw a slow priming of one replica due to an initial connection reset to the internal mirror.
- Fallback routing: policy bundle applied; edge gateway shows rotated lanes enabled. We validated route preferences with BGP community tagging.
- Smoke gen: 100 concurrent small-gen run — p99 at 162ms for the dedicated pool (just above 150ms).

We’ll attach traces and a short write-up by 11:00 PT with next steps. We can do a focused remediation play (re-run spiral and force-reconnect to the mirror) and then re-execute the smoke within the same window if you want to re-run signoff.

John
John Park
Director, SRE — ACME Cloud
[Attachment: acme_spike_notes.zip]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, John Park <john.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Postflight resilience check + runbook closure for VPC private deployment

Thanks John — good findings. Proposed quick remediation steps (I’ll coordinate execution):
1) Sergio will trigger a controlled mirror reconnect for replica-2 and monitor priming throughput. This addresses the KV prefill lag.
2) Marissa will adjust the spiral tester to extend the hold period at the egress hop to capture a 30s window of packet behaviour; we want to rule out transient NIC queue bounces.
3) I’ll push a minor tuning to the batching window (reduce max batch wait from 12ms to 8ms) and spin the 100-concurrent smoke again. If p99 still >150ms we’ll revert and capture perf traces.

Sergio / Marissa — can you confirm ETA on steps 1–2? If we can re-run the spiral and smoke by 13:30 PT today we should be able to close the loop and publish closure notes to INF-4823.

[Attachment: redwood_runbook_postflight_v1.pdf — note section 4.2 updated with the mirror-reconnect command and observability hooks]

Laura
Sr. Manager, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Park <john.park@acmecloud.com>, Kate Summers <kate.summers@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2028 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Postflight resilience check + runbook closure for VPC private deployment

All —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Final status:
- Mirror reconnect completed (Sergio) at 12:48 PT; KV prefill hit-rate now 97% during a 90s window — logs attached.
- Egress spiral: extended capture shows the earlier spike correlates with a transient MTU mismatch on the on-prem edge (we raised an MR with their network team). No persistent packet loss after tuning; adjusted runbook note added.
- Smoke gen: after batching-tuning, p99 measured 138ms (sample window 1000 requests).

Given the green light on the three primary checks, we’re closing INF-4823 and publishing the postflight closure doc. I pushed the final runbook snapshot to the Drive link and attached the runbook PDF with an edit summary.

Closure artifacts saved: redwood_runbook_postflight_v1.pdf (finalized), egress_acl_spiral_test_results.csv (final traces), kv-prefill-log-20280509.txt (postfix).

If ACME requires a follow-up 30-day stability review we can schedule a one-hour checkpoint; otherwise we’ll transition monitoring to your SRE team’s on-call rotation.

Thanks everyone for the rapid execution — nice team effort.

Jonas
Director, Deployment Reliability
Redwood Inference
[Related: JIRA-INF-4823, Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B_runbook_postflight]
